ns2:section.sectionText: 3 hour. Topic: Analysis of Biological Data in R This course will focus on developing skills in the use of R. It will cover the book 'The Analysis of Biological Data' by Whitlock and Schluter who created a website with R code to accompany the book. It will also use 'The R Graphics Cookbook". Students will be assigned weekly problem sets to be performed in R and will share their R-code and show how they solved problems. Weekly quizzes will occur on the assigned reading. There will also be student presentations of data analyses. Students must bring their own laptops to class. No prior experience with R is necessary.
